newsitem.title: USA: Stephan sees year net up.
newsitem.headline: Stephan sees year net up.

text.p: Stephan Co said Thursday it anticipates reporting an increase in its earnings per share and net income based on comparable sales for the year ended December 31, 1996, subject to completion of its annual audit.
Stephan, which makes personal care products, also said it has signed a letter of intent to acquire New Image Laboratories Inc of Oxnard, Calif.
Stephan said the transaction is subject to, among other things, negotiation of a definitive agreement and completion of due diligence.
New Image makes and markets professional, ethnic and retail hair care products.
Stephan said the proposed transaction could increase its sales in excess of $15.0 million on an annualized basis.
